name: StudeQ
summary: AI-backed full-stack study platform for students featuring intelligent note taking, automated quizzes, flashcards, and PDF-based chat. Serves over 100 active users.
highlights: Developed full stack with end-to-end ownership: Next.js/React frontend, Node.js/Express backend, and cloud deployment on Render.
Designed secure REST APIs with JWT authentication, cookie management, and Zod input validation.
Built background job queue with Redis and BullMQ for document processing and AI workloads.
Integrated Razorpay payment gateway with verified webhooks and managed SEO and organic growth.

name: Nexus - Zero-Dependency Reverse Proxy & API Gateway
summary: Production-grade reverse proxy and API gateway built strictly using Node.js standard library (`node:*` built-ins) without any third-party npm dependencies.
highlights: Implemented TLS termination, dynamic path routing, health checks, round-robin load balancing, and rate limiting with zero external dependencies.
Built a live metrics dashboard and authentication verification layer directly in native Node.js streams.
Documented architectural design and performance characteristics in featured Hashnode article.

name: YouTube-like Scalable Backend System
summary: Highly scalable video platform backend supporting video upload, transcoding, streaming schemas, and real-time user engagement.
highlights: Engineered asynchronous video processing pipeline with BullMQ + FFmpeg for automatic multi-resolution transcoding (240p to 1080p).
Implemented access and refresh token JWT authentication, video metadata caching with Redis, and live-streaming database collections.
Refactored architecture from monolith towards modular microservices to optimize independent service scaling.

name: Content Automation Pipeline
summary: Autonomous publishing pipeline that extracts code changes from GitHub, performs analysis via Groq LLM API, and publishes technical articles to Hashnode and Dev.to.
highlights: Automated code review extraction and blog draft generation on a scheduled cron cadence.
Enabled cross-platform publishing with automated tag and markdown formatting.

name: ScanBeforeEat
summary: Mobile-first Progressive Web App (PWA) that decodes complex food ingredient labels into clear, evidence-based consumer health intelligence.
highlights: Translates cryptic food additives and chemical codes into intuitive health insights.
Designed mobile-first with offline PWA support.

name: know_about_me (Know Myself Context Hub)
summary: Single source of truth multi-agent context hub and MCP server connecting personal developer background, skills, and weekly updates across Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and Antigravity.
highlights: Exposes FastMCP tools and REST API endpoints for seamless LLM integration.
Automated compilation of llms.txt and single-prompt profile context.
Continuous deployment via GitHub Pages.

name: Claude Code Skills Library
summary: Comprehensive production AI agent skills library (425+ skills) designed for Claude Code, Antigravity, and autonomous agent frameworks with automated CI validation and synchronization.
highlights: Architected automated skill router (find-skill.py) and skill synchronization script (sync_skills.py).
Maintains 425+ battle-tested domain skills covering system architecture, security auditing, TDD, and full-stack development.
Continuous automated validation pipeline running on GitHub Actions.

name: BloodBankOS - Hospital & Donor Management Platform
summary: Full-stack healthcare operations platform managing real-time blood inventory, emergency donor matching, and hospital allocation workflows.
highlights: Built real-time blood stock tracking and multi-tier blood group compatibility matching engine.
Implemented secure hospital administrative dashboards and donor registry management.

name: KnowYourWB - Bengal Heritage Atlas
summary: Interactive cultural and historical heritage exploration portal celebrating monuments, history, and geographical diversity of West Bengal.
highlights: Interactive geospatial atlas detailing districts, historical landmarks, festivals, and cultural heritage of Bengal.
Optimized for fast mobile rendering and rich multimedia discovery.

name: Job-Portal & JobFlux Platform
summary: Production-ready full-stack job board connecting tech talent with employers, featuring candidate application pipelines, role filtering, and recruiter dashboards.
highlights: Engineered REST APIs for job postings, application submissions, and resume handling.
Integrated recruiter workflows with candidate tracking status and role filtering.

name: NutriTrack Pro (IEEE HackHustle)
summary: Smart nutrition and dietary tracking web application developed during IEEE HackHustle for personalized health analytics.
highlights: Built macronutrient breakdown calculators and automated dietary suggestion pipelines.
Delivered complete working prototype under high-pressure hackathon deadlines.
